instruction_tuning.name: OneThinker-SFT-Qwen3-8B
instruction_tuning.summary: OneThinker-SFT-Qwen3-8B是基于Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct进行监督微调的多模态AI模型，专精于图像与文本的跨模态理解与生成，解决了单一模态AI在复杂场景下的局限性。其核心在于通过高质量训练数据优化原模型的指令跟随能力，实现了从任意输入到文本输出的灵活推理。开发者可通过Hugging Face快速集成，应用于视觉问答、图文内容分析等场景，或以其为基座开发定制化多模态工具，探索更智能的人机交互方式。
instruction_tuning.summary_en: OneThinker-SFT-Qwen3-8B is a fine-tuned multimodal AI model that excels at understanding and generating responses from diverse inputs including images and text, addressing the need for versatile AI assistants. It builds on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning with curated datasets, enabling robust any-to-any reasoning across modalities. Developers can deploy it via Hugging Face for applications like visual question answering, content analysis, or as a foundation for custom multimodal projects, leveraging its open-source Apache 2.0 license for experimentation.

text_to_image.name: Qwen3.5-0.8B
text_to_image.summary: Qwen3.5-0.8B 是一个仅含 8 亿参数的多模态语言模型，专为在计算资源有限的设备上实现流畅对话和图文理解而设计。其技术亮点在于通过高效的架构设计，在极小参数量下保持了出色的推理能力，这使得模型能在手机或嵌入式设备上高效运行。开发者可基于其基础模型进行微调，构建个性化的智能助手或文档分析工具，也可直接通过 Hugging Face 平台快速集成，探索实时多模态交互的应用场景。
text_to_image.summary_en: Qwen3.5-0.8B is a compact 0.8-billion-parameter multimodal language model that enables conversational AI and image-text understanding on resource-constrained devices. Its technical innovation lies in efficient architecture design that maintains strong reasoning capabilities despite the small parameter count, making it suitable for edge deployment. Developers can fine-tune it for specific applications like smart assistants or document analysis, or integrate it directly via Hugging Face's transformers library for real-time multimodal interactions.

speaker_separation.name: speaker-diarization-community-1
speaker_separation.summary: Speaker-diarization-community-1 是一款开源音频处理模型，专注于多人对话中的说话人识别与分割，可自动标注录音中各发言者的时间片段。该模型集成了语音活动检测、说话人切换识别和重叠语音处理三大功能，采用先检测语音段再区分说话人的级联流程，在交叉对话场景中仍能保持较高准确度。适用于会议记录转录、播客字幕生成、客服对话分析等场景，也可作为基础模块集成至实时通讯工具，为语音分析应用提供可靠的说话人分离能力。
speaker_separation.summary_en: Speaker-diarization-community-1 is an open-source audio processing pipeline that automatically identifies and segments different speakers in conversations, solving the challenge of tracking who speaks when in multi-person recordings. It combines voice activity detection, speaker change detection, and overlapped speech recognition into a unified workflow, enabling precise speaker separation even during interruptions. Researchers can use it to analyze meeting transcripts, create accessible media with speaker labels, or integrate it into real-time communication tools for better conversation analytics.
speaker_separation.summary_zh: Speaker-diarization-community-1 是一款开源音频处理模型，专注于多人对话中的说话人识别与分割，可自动标注录音中各发言者的时间片段。该模型集成了语音活动检测、说话人切换识别和重叠语音处理三大功能，采用先检测语音段再区分说话人的级联流程，在交叉对话场景中仍能保持较高准确度。适用于会议记录转录、播客字幕生成、客服对话分析等场景，也可作为基础模块集成至实时通讯工具，为语音分析应用提供可靠的说话人分离能力。
